title: Coherent nerve, categorical equivalences and replacement interfaces
statement: Fix a sufficiently large universe $u$ and simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Use quasicategories, Kan complexes, enriched mapping sets, cores, internal functor objects and weak homotopy equivalences [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the coherent localization universal property [def-coef-coherent-localization-interface]. A small simplicial category is a category enriched in simplicial sets, with its objects and mapping simplices in $u$. Write $\mathrm{sCat}_u$ for their ordinary category: morphisms are enriched functors and composition is enriched-functor composition. Its underlying ordinary category has arrows the vertices of the enriched mapping sets. Locally Kan means that every mapping simplicial set is Kan. Discrete means that, for every mapping simplicial set $X$ and every $n$, the operator $X_0\to X_n$ induced by the unique map $[n]\to[0]$ is bijective. Its coherent nerve is the existing subset-poset simplicial nerve; on enriched functors it is postcomposition in every degree. Write $\mathrm{QCat}_u$ for the full ordinary subcategory of simplicial sets on quasicategories, with all simplicial maps. A map $f:X\to Y$ is a categorical equivalence if, for every quasicategory $T$, the restriction $\operatorname{Fun}(Y,T)^{\simeq}\to\operatorname{Fun}(X,T)^{\simeq}$ of cores is a weak homotopy equivalence. In $\mathrm{QCat}_u$ invert the coherent functor equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. The enlarged nerve map of an ordinary functor sends every lifted string of arrows to its image string. A normalized locally Kan replacement datum consists of a functor $R:\mathrm{sCat}_u\to\mathrm{sCat}_u$ and a natural transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to R$ such that $RA$ has the same object set as $A$, $\eta_A$ is the identity on objects and a weak homotopy equivalence on every mapping set, and every $RA$ is locally Kan. On discrete simplicial categories $RA=A$ and $\eta_A=\mathrm{id}$, and $R$ fixes every map between discrete categories, using the specified equalities to transport types. This defines the data and its conditions, without asserting existence.
